algorithm: Load complete immutable ADMIN-installed digest-pinned roster from trusted host configuration; validate package/target/approval/custody and no duplicates. No SQL service EXECUTE or client identity argument.
Derive authenticated OID/session OID/exact catalog name/database/backend native identity server-side. SECURITY DEFINER current_user never identifies caller.
ADMIN exact postgres identity is not a roster service; trusted administrative emergency admission is outside operational enrollment, never a service proxy.

Let matches be roster entries whose OID equals authenticated OID OR whose exact authoritative name equals catalog name. If one component matches but pair/purpose/attributes does not, DENY; never downgrade rename/recreation to unmanaged.
If no component matches and the complete trusted roster is valid, take unaffected unmanaged path. No prefix/regex/wildcard/ACL-only classification.

If exactly one approved allocated pair matches, role is governed independent of headers. Query/validate canonical header slots, full fingerprint/context, original input, current host approval and policy linkage; zero/missing or more than one eligible matching assignment DENY.
Only validated governed match reaches retained self-pidfd/SCM_RIGHTS synchronous ACCEPT/DENY; no ReadyForQuery/usability until ACCEPT. No PID fallback.
Readiness and R/M remain separate runtime guards; enrollment never creates command authority or marks READY. No heartbeat/ACK duration invented.

active_binding_semantics.boundary: Do not silently impose M ACTIVE-only admission on AUDITOR and remove R rights. Any requested stronger ACTIVE-only-all-slots rule needs a separate normative amendment.
